Validate a mapping against an object

Source: R/contract_validate.R
validateMapping.Rd

Check a mapping against a profiled object (structural checks) and, when result is given, check the converted giotto object (semantic checks). No conversion is run here.

Structural: schema, parameter binding, source paths, target keys under the Giotto contract, hooks, and data in the source that is neither mapped nor declared lossy. Semantic: raw expression is integer-valued and non-negative, cell IDs agree across parts, dimensions match the profile, coordinate ranges are plausible for microns, reductions and networks index the cells.

Usage

validateMapping(
  mapping,
  profile,
  params = NULL,
  result = NULL,
  checks = c("all", "structural", "semantic")
)

Arguments

mapping

a giottoMapping, mapping file or bundled mapping id

profile

giottoProfile of the source object

params

optional bound params (as returned internally by the engine)

result

optional giotto object produced with this mapping

checks

"all", "structural" or "semantic" (the latter requires result)

Value

a giottoValidation data.frame with columns check, part_id, level (OK, WARN, FAIL) and message
